# DAO Studio

> Make AI useful through composed applications, coordinated response and capabilities others can build upon.



- [About DAO Studio](https://daostudio.in/about/index.md): How an ambition to help people create decentralised, autonomous organisations became three ways to make AI capability useful. ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/about/))

([HTML](https://daostudio.in/blog/evolution-of-ai-and-its-future-in-b2b/))

- [Follow the data, not the deployment label](https://daostudio.in/blog/follow-the-data/index.md): A document can begin on the customer's machine while its request, trace and feedback continue through other services. ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/blog/follow-the-data/))

([HTML](https://daostudio.in/blog/turning-service-work-into-reusable-capability/))

([HTML](https://daostudio.in/collections/composing-ai-work/from-composition-to-a-deliberate-change/agent-playbook-and-application/))

([HTML](https://daostudio.in/collections/composing-ai-work/from-composition-to-a-deliberate-change/from-feedback-to-a-version-worth-using/))

- [Reading the work behind an answer](https://daostudio.in/collections/composing-ai-work/from-composition-to-a-deliberate-change/reading-the-work-behind-an-answer/index.md): Following a disputed payment term through retrieval, extraction and review turns a wrong answer into a useful investigation. ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/collections/composing-ai-work/from-composition-to-a-deliberate-change/reading-the-work-behind-an-answer/))

Standalone essays are on the Blog. ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/collections/))

([HTML](https://daostudio.in/collections/protocols-and-reuse/a-court-before-the-consequence/a-precognition-court-for-ai/))

([HTML](https://daostudio.in/collections/protocols-and-reuse/a-court-before-the-consequence/))

- [When an approval reaches the effect](https://daostudio.in/collections/protocols-and-reuse/a-court-before-the-consequence/when-an-approval-reaches-the-effect/index.md): A document-release example: an approval names the version it examined, the release path checks it, and the record says what happened. ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/collections/protocols-and-reuse/a-court-before-the-consequence/when-an-approval-reaches-the-effect/))

- [Some things never change. It’s time they do…](https://daostudio.in/collections/protocols-and-reuse/some-things-never-change/index.md): From YojnAI’s memory wrappers to a harder question: how could learned capacities be recombined, and what would useful reuse have to preserve? ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/collections/protocols-and-reuse/some-things-never-change/))
